retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy pop concert aesthetic featuring a central performer under bright stage lights with multi-layered marquee and script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring a female pop singer in a mid-performance pose, set against a bokeh-heavy cyan stage light background, anchored by a complex, multi-styled typographic logo in the lower left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's raised arm creates a diagonal line leading from the bottom-left logo to the top-left corner.
The warm blonde hair and skin tones contrast against the cool cyan and blue background.
The magenta clothing provides a vibrant mid-tone that bridges the warm subject and cool background.
Typography uses a mix of textures—light bulbs, metallic gold, and solid purple—to create depth.
coreInvariants: High-key stage lighting with visible bokeh circles
Saturated palette of cyan, magenta, and gold

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The performer is positioned on the right half of the frame, scaled to a medium-close-up, with one arm extended diagonally across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The complex typographic block in the lower-left quadrant serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face of the performer, follows the microphone hand, then moves down to the logo, and finally up the extended arm to the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top-left and right edges are filled with abstract light flares and bokeh, providing breathing room for the busy central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and electric blue (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta and hot pink (clothing and accents)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and yellow (marquee lights and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high value contrast between the dark shadows of the clothing and the bright white stage flares.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs mixed with fluid script
letterConstructionRules: Primary initials are oversized with internal light bulb patterns
Secondary text uses blocky, sans-serif forms with metallic gradients
Tertiary text uses a thick, monolinear script with a gold foil texture
Heavy black drop shadows are used to separate text layers
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'M' are rendered as marquee signs with glowing dots
The script text features an elongated swash underlining the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking a rigid, illuminated slab serif with a soft, organic script to create a 'glamour vs. personal' contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, theatrical slab-serif base for marquee effects.
Captures the fluid, energetic feel of the secondary script text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-energy concert scene with a blonde female singer holding a microphone, arm raised, against a vibrant cyan and blue background with heavy white bokeh and lens flares. The singer wears a magenta top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a multi-layered logo in the bottom left. Use a marquee-style slab serif for the main initials with glowing bulb textures, a blocky sans-serif for the middle text, and a gold-textured script for the bottom word with a decorative swash.

verificationChecks: Is the marquee light effect visible inside the large letters?
Does the cyan background contrast sharply with the magenta clothing?
Is the composition dominated by a strong diagonal gesture?
Are there at least three distinct typographic styles layered together?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the stage lighting (e.g., purple vs cyan)
Complexity of the marquee bulb pattern
mustRedesign: Do not use existing entertainment logos
Ensure all text is original and not transcribed
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the complex typography
Ensure the subject's face is the brightest point of the image
Verify the gold texture looks metallic rather than flat yellow
Confirm the background lights do not distract from the text legibility
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Concert Lighting] + [Diagonal Performer Pose] + [Layered Marquee & Script Typography] + [Cyan/Magenta Palette] to create a teen-pop idol aesthetic.
